newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle active $106/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle active $106/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active on Tuesday morning, with prices on slaughter steers and heifers live basis mostly $1.00 higher than Monday, dressed basis firm to $1.00 higher, USDA said.

Buyer inquiry and demand good. Seller interest fairly good at the higher bids. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1325 lbs 65.00-66.00, latter price delivered; Dressed basis - 105.00-106.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 65.00; Dressed basis - 105.00-106.00. Confirmed - 9,500 For the week - 34,600
